'''D. Beasley''' was a Systems Engineering Director at the [[Imperial Navy Research, Development and Engineering Center]], as well as at the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation Research, Development and Engineering Center]], the [[Incom Corporation Research, Development and Engineering Center]], and the [[SoroSuub Corporation Research, Development and Engineering Center]].

==Biography==
This individual worked on the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']]{{'s}} design, as well as on the [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder's]] design, the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter's]] design, and the basic design of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that became the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
